answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a summit of peers, with the stake slashed if duplicate identities are proven. Like water carving karst, cheap identities erode trust slowly, so the deposit must exceed the profit of one fake vote — a violet-tier bond worth a day of compute. Forging a hundred sock-puppets then costs a hundred bonds plus the compute to keep each alive, while honest agents recover their stake in full.
